claim_coverage.claim: Source A.1 temporal-order error and conventions
claim_coverage.result: Confirmed against Appendix A definitions and actual forward-base assertion.
Verified exact algebra, rank transitions, finite-cycle ergodicity, both faithfulness conditions and all-length persistence.
Verified word-level identity, E_hat_n=T^n E_n, fixed-block distribution equality and absence of unwarranted onset inference.
Verified full-span persistence, countable full-measure intersection, equality of first/eventual times and laws including infinity, but not pointwise equality.
Verified all stated subspace products and onsets (2,3), (infinity,infinity), reverse (2,infinity); equal fixed-block probabilities do not determine onset laws.
Verified g circ T^(n-1)<=a_n and stationarity argument forcing Phi(I)>0 almost surely without ergodicity or invertibility.
Verified countable level sets, noninvertible/nonergodic Poincare recurrence, recurrent random spectral floor, CP persistence and measurable finite first full rank.
Verified from trace-one targets and cocycle identity on a common full-measure set; no arbitrary normalized non-TP generalization follows.

Verified q<=ell and converse via actual MS Assumption 1/Theorems 1-2 with invertible ergodic base, scalar d normalization, P=(Tr a/d)Z, endpoints (0,n-1), x=0, exponent n-1, and tilde_z=z_MS circ T^-1. Clarify existential rate.
Confirmed: proper Kraus span does not imply common kernel; a TP Kraus tuple has no common nonzero right-kernel vector.
A.3 and Sanz autonomous antecedent correctly cited; MS is imported. Main source parent/gap theorems are neither refuted nor certified. Recurrence antecedents and search limits retained.
